title: A Bejeweled Plateau
subject: Ngangla Ringco lake, Tibetan Plateau
credit: Astronaut photograph by an Expedition 71 crew member. Provided by the ISS Crew Earth Observations Facility and the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, Johnson Space Center, NASA.
identity: Actual astronaut photograph of Ngangla Ringco, captured using a Nikon Z9 with a 400 millimeter lens. The published NASA image includes labels. The original NASA editorial preparation cropped and enhanced contrast and removed lens artifacts, as disclosed in the source record.
scope: An example of observing a Tibetan Plateau lake. It is not a claim about current water level, weather, tourism access or a proposed travel stop.
usage: Used for factual educational/informational purposes with attribution under NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines. The primary record identifies an ISS crew photograph supplied by NASA/JSC and contains no separate third-party copyright notice. No endorsement is implied.
localProcessing: None. Downloaded NASA's 720 by 480 web rendition unchanged. Thumbnail is displayed with CSS object-fit:cover and object-position:50% 55%; no image generation, recoloring or compositing.
